data.title: US' uncrewed warfare capabilities to get boost with new robotic vehicle
data.description: Rather than serving as conventional operational vehicles, the robotic ground vehicles will initially function as experimentation and integration testbeds, allowing Marines to evaluate different payloads, sensors and mission configurations.
data.author: Prabhat Ranjan Mishra
data.keywords: uncrewed warfare, uncrewed warfare capabilities, US' uncrewed warfare capabilities, warfare capabilities
